name: Mark
author: Traditionally John Mark, associated with Peter. The book itself is anonymous.
date: Often dated between about AD 55 and 70.
setting: Written in a brisk style, likely for a wider audience, including Gentile readers.
theme: Jesus is the Son of God who came to serve and give his life as a ransom.

outline.label: The Last Supper, Gethsemane, and trial

christInBook: Mark moves quickly to show Jesus as the Son of God who came to serve and to give his life as a ransom for many (10:45). The centurion at the cross is the first human to confess him as the Son of God (15:39).
howToRead: Mark is the shortest Gospel and the most action-driven. Watch for the word “immediately.” Notice how often Jesus tells people not to tell, and how the disciples struggle to understand.
